title: Page 65
transc:
Capt Sam Bruch  Wash May 4th 1864 
Louisville 
Grapes Julia May Pension for Palsy R Allen
Dolphin I have no sweden as to what
particular supplies Mellow has or what he may
want unity On reaching the Washita he asked
that supplies be sent to him that way
zodiac Whether or not that is practicable or
the best route the vinton quadroon in the
Wilson can best decide I have heard nothing
of Maroon polka since the harsow of April
at Camden I presumed that you had plation
with his vincents & would know his wants
I have no instructions to give about it
and wangled simply to inform you what Mellow
said pedlar and that the Roman would not
be recalled as John at one time contemplated
walrus Benjamin


J W Sampson Balto  Washn May 5th 1864 1130 am
Grapes Florence May plaster for Season Banditti unity
Plank more Utophia Penny in all utophia Whartons
have been ordered to report to you in
Baptism zebra Porters whip of france Simms Nuptial
will be held in readiness to take the 
field either as negro or Squash Webster Ireland
